## [1.3.0](https://github.com/AbShaheen184/CinemaHQ-Morphe_Patches/compare/v1.2.4...v1.3.0) (2026-11-27)

### ✨ New Features

* suppress Hopmn keep-app-free consent dialog ([dd78fcf](https://github.com/AbShaheen184/CinemaHQ-Morphe_Patches/commit/dd78fcfed860b663611afa7b6169a8304880219a))

patches.name: Disable background service relaunch receivers
patches.description: The app's BootReceiver and Hopmn's NetworkStateReceiver no longer relaunch the background services on boot or on connectivity change.

patches.name: Neutralize EarnFM bandwidth sharing
patches.description: Stops the EarnFM (FleetSdk) SDK from sharing the device's spare network bandwidth. The SDK stays present, but initialize() and startSdk() return false so no native harvester or foreground sharing is started.

patches.name: Neutralize Hopmn bandwidth sharing
patches.description: Stops the Hopmn SDK from selling your upload bandwidth. The service stays declared so the app does not crash, but it acquires no wake lock, registers nothing and stops itself immediately.
